recipes.name: Laurie's Cheesy Tomato Pasta
ingredients_raw: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 pound kielbasa sausage, cut into 1 inch pieces

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain and reserve.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
In a medium bowl, combine cream of mushroom soup, tomato soup, cheese, kielbasa and pasta; mix well. Pour mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly; serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Laurie's Cheesy Tomato Pasta
raw_recipe.description: A creamy pasta dish with many different delicious flavors. Serve with garlic bread and a green salad, if desired.

review.reviewBody: This was delicious!! I sauteed the kielbasa with garlic first then added rest of ingredients. Also added half of cheese inside and the other on top.thanks for the recipe!!

We love this! I've used kielbasa, smoked sausage, hot dogs and turkey dogs, depending on what I have in the freezer. I use at least 6 oz of cheddar, and mix it all in. None on top. Double the soup so it's nice and juicy. Cover with foil.

I like this recipe with a couple of alterations...I, too, sauteed the kielbasa and then added one clove of garlic towards the end. I substituted one jar of spaghetti sauce for the tomato soup and used penne pasta and a little less cheese.
This was good, not phenomenal. Like others recommended, I sauteed the kielbasa with onion and garlic before mixing with the other ingredients.

I liked the pasta and sauce much more than I thought but the kielbasa tasted out of place. I had browned it in garlic and had to keep my husband from eating it as I waited for the pasta to cook. He didn't like it as much in the pasta. I think I might try it with chicken. Would be easy with the pre-cooked grilled chicken. This would make a good dish for leftover turkey.

I also used cavatappi pasta as I couldn't imagine it with spaghetti. I sprinked some dried onion in with the soup mixture as well.

We all loved this! I made it just as it's written too - well except for mixing in half the cheese and using the rest to put on top. And we only baked it for 20 minutes (oh ya I had sauteed the cut up kielbasa with a little onion & garlic first) because everything was already cooked. We will have this again!
Yummy! Not what I expected! I did use mild Italian sausage which added a bit of zing! My husband went back for seconds and was happy there were leftovers for him to take to work!

I would say those that did not give it 5 stars was because they did not like kielbasa sausage. But it is a favorite here and we loved it! I did not have tomato soup, so after i put the cream of mushroom in, I put a small amount of ketchup in the can and the rest of it water. And I did not have 2 cups shredded cheese, so I used one cup and one cup mozz. cheese. I know that my grandchildren and sister would love it because they love kielbasa sausage along with us. So I suggest you don't try it and give it bad reviews if you do not like it. Thanks Laurie!!!!!

I was not quite sure about this, but needed a quick kielbasa recipe. Normally, I shy away from casseroles that require 2 cans of condensed soup, but for some reason this one overcame my misgivings and I made it tonight. It was really good! My husband loved it! My kids...well, they are really picky and don't like sauce on pasta, so they didn't care for it, but it has a mild flavor and tastes very cheesey, so most kids should really love it. I kept back about 1/2 cup of the cheese and put it on top. I definitely will make this one again.

Very easy and quick, Tasted nothing like spaghetti-o's like some other reviewers mentioned although it did smell like them before baking. Used Fettuccine instead of spaghetti and added about 1/2C of extra cheese on top. Great taste, even my 2yr old loved it!
Everyone loved it! Including the kids
Not very exciting. It may have been because I used cream of celery (didn't have mushroom). The 1 yr old in the family liked it, but the 7 and 5 yr olds didn't (and they like chef boyardee).
The only one that ate it was the one-year old. Probably because it tastes exactly like chef boyrdee. The older kids had seconds on salad and garlic bread because this was so bad.
Easy, yummy (especially for leftovers), kid's liked it, husband liked it, inexpensive.
Ugh, we didn't like this at all. Will not be making again.

This was kind of odd, it's true, but it tasted good and my 3-year-old liked it. It's kind of gloppy and strange, and I wouldn't serve it to company or anything, but it was easy, tasty, and I always have these ingredients on hand, so I've made it a few times!

I really didn't enjoy this recipe. My boyfriend thought it was okay, but it was way too bland for me even though I added some garlic and a little cayenne pepper. I agree with the other reviewer, it definitely reminded me of spaghetti oh's. I won't be making this one again.
